title: Lock Admin V0.2 source hierarchy
summary: The source-of-truth document controls implementation decisions when generated frames or old planning notes disagree.
rationale: This prevents the next implementation agent from averaging inconsistent generated frames into a generic admin UI.
alternatives_considered: Use frame implementation plan as literal task list
Let each implementer reinterpret frame priority
risks: If the source hierarchy is bypassed, first-slice implementation can drift into unrelated secondary modules.
